under: under — under, beneath (preposition) · under — beneath, below (adverb, after its noun)

wundrum: wundor — wonder, marvel (neuter, dative plural, instrumental; also adverbial 'wondrously'; cf. 'wonder')

wōd: wadan — strode, advanced (3rd singular preterite; cf. 'wade')

ðe: þe — who, which, that (the relative particle, here spelled ðe) · þe — the particle joined to a demonstrative to form a conjunction (þæs ðe 'because, that') · þe — the particle joined to a conjunction (þēah ðe 'although', þæt ðe 'that')
ðone: sē — the, that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative)
ðæt: þæt — that (conjunction, here spelled ðæt; oð ðæt 'until') · þæt — that (neuter demonstrative pronoun, nominative singular, spelled ðæt; ðæt wæs ... ðēodnes: þēoden — lord, prince, king (masculine, genitive singular)
ðū: þū — you (2nd person singular pronoun, spelled ðū; cf. 'thou')
